query: LTXV workflow fails after updating ComfyUI Desktop to v0.5.0 (core v0.3.63): LTXVBaseSampler errors with 'LTXVPreprocess' object has no attribute 'preprocess'. Reproduced on macOS, Windows and Ubuntu desktop builds; reinstalling LTXV nodes from Manager did not help.

desired.outcome: Fixed in ComfyUI Desktop v0.5.1 (core v0.3.64); OP confirmed 'v0.5.1(core v.0.3.64) fixed the issue.'
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies the correct root cause; proposed fix is actionable and directionally correct.
